description: A Swift class 'GatewayServiceResolver' that uses NetService to resolve Bonjour services for endpoint discovery without relying on TXT records. It manages service resolution, handles success and failure, and normalizes hostnames.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: A resolver for Bonjour services using NetService, providing asynchronous resolution with a callback.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with a service name, type, domain, and a completion handler.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the resolution process with an optional timeout.

methods.name: netServiceDidResolveAddress
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when the service address is successfully resolved.

methods.name: netService:didNotResolve
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when service resolution fails.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Handles cleanup and invokes the completion handler with the result.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Static method to normalize hostname strings.
